title: Annulus fibrosus
summary: Simulate each annulus test mode (lamella, uniaxial circumferential/axial/radial, biaxial, shear, bone-AF-bone) and report the requested modulus, ratio or failure value.
simulate: Build the specimen of each mode at its stated size: lamella or strip, cruciform, cube/sheet/cylinder, or bone-AF-bone slice.
Orient fibres for the region (outer/inner, anterior/posterior); fibre angle about 23-50 deg to the transverse plane.
Grip the ends (strips), shear plates or embedded bone; leave lateral faces free unless the mode is biaxial.
Load quasi-statically in the stated direction to the stated strain, stress or failure; use equilibrium response where stated.
Report the outcome as defined: toe/linear/tangent modulus, Poisson ratio, stress at strain, shear modulus, failure value.

notes: Modulus definitions are never mixed: toe, linear-region, single-fit, tangent-at-stress and stress-band moduli are separate outputs; Elliott values are equilibrium, others quasi-static.
Degenerated tissue is in separate tasks (suffix _dg). Bass curves and biaxial points are one representative specimen; Wagner curve is the mean-coefficient fit (derived).

agent_prompt: You are given a constitutive or finite element model of human lumbar annulus fibrosus. For every task in this card, build the specimen described by its inputs (test mode, region, degeneration, and the strain, stress band or shear strain where given), apply the stated boundary conditions and quasi-static loading, and compute the requested output exactly as defined: toe or linear-region modulus from a bilinear fit, stress-band modulus, tangent modulus at the given stress, Poisson ratio from lateral/axial strain, stress at the given strain, equilibrium shear modulus, or failure stress/strain. Use the same model parameters for all tasks; do not refit per task. Return one JSON object following answer_format: task id -> {output key: value} in the stated units. Use null for tasks your model cannot simulate.
